tasks.title: Position harvesting on a schedule and reports per site, city and keyword with CSV export (EN/RU)
interfaces: lib/positions/harvest.ts: export async function harvest(deps: { client: MagicSeoClient; kv; projects: { id: number; domain: string; region: number; name: string }[]; today: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */; pauseMs?: number /* default 1000 between projects */ }): Promise<{ projects: number; checks: number }> — reads positions(id, { from, to: today }) where from = last harvested date of that project or today − 30 days, merges into KV keys partitioned by month 'pos:<projectId>:<YYYY-MM>' as { keyword: { date: { pc, mobile, url } } } and writes 'pos-meta:<projectId>' { lastDate }

lib/positions/report.ts: export type ReportRow = { site: string; city: string; keyword: string; date: string; pcPosition: number | null; mobilePosition: number | null; foundUrl: string }; export async function reportRows(kv, projects, filter: { domain: string; region?: number; keyword?: string; from: string; to: string }): Promise<ReportRow[]>; export function toCsv(rows: ReportRow[]): string

server/positions-handlers.ts (`import type` only from sdk): createPositionsHandlers(deps) returning { positions_report(filter), positions_csv(filter), positions_harvest_now() }; server/positions.ts: positionsRpc, positionsHandlers(ctx), registerPositions(ctx) harvesting through bb.background.schedule('positions', '*/10 * * * *', …) once config.positionsIntervalHours have passed since 'pos-meta:last-run'.; it imports lib modules by relative .ts paths so `node --test` runs it without npm install.
invariants: Harvesting only reads (GET positions); it never calls startPositionsJob or any mutation.
MagicSEO position 101 is stored as 101 and shown in the UI as '100+'; CSV keeps 101.
CSV header is exactly `site,city,keyword,date,pc_position,mobile_position,found_url`, fields with comma, quote or newline are double-quoted with inner quotes doubled.
All user-visible strings come from i18n/reports.ts with `export const ru: Record<keyof typeof en, string>`; ui/reports-tab.css has no hex colours.
Follow the pattern and conventions of these files outside this repository (read them before writing): /Users/vechkasov/Documents/BB-сервис/docs/DESIGN.md.
Files under .bb/ and .agents/ are untracked: when a worktree lacks them, read them at /Users/vechkasov/Documents/BB-сервис/plugins/magicseo/<same path>.
BB plugin KV holds at most 256 KiB (262144 bytes) per key: every value this task writes stays below that size. Position history is split into one key per project and month.
out_of_scope: Report recipients, e-mail/Telegram delivery and report format beyond the table and CSV (deferred)
Manual paid position checks (T3 has the button)
acceptance: `node --test tests/positions/harvest.test.ts` exits 0; with a fake client returning tests/fixtures/positions-sample.json (a trimmed copy of positions_527041_full_range.json) it asserts the first harvest requests from = today − 30 days, the second harvest requests from = the stored lastDate, checks dated in two months land in two keys 'pos:<id>:2026-06' and 'pos:<id>:2026-07', the merged value keeps checks of both runs, position 101 is stored as 101, the fake client receives 0 mutating calls, and a generated month of 100 keywords × 31 days serializes below 262144 characters.

`node --test tests/positions/report.test.ts` exits 0; reportRows filters by domain, region and keyword and date range, city comes from cityByRegion, and toCsv output starts with the line `site,city,keyword,date,pc_position,mobile_position,found_url` and quotes a keyword containing a comma.

`node --test tests/server/positions-handlers.test.ts` exits 0 (positions_csv returns the toCsv text for the filter; positions_harvest_now returns { projects, checks }), `npm install --no-audit --no-fund --silent && npm run build` exits 0 and `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` exits 0.
`grep -c 'Record<keyof typeof en, string>' i18n/reports.ts` prints 1.
qa_cases: [UI-observable] QA-W3-2: Open the MagicSEO app, tab Reports, pick site proart-show.ru, press Harvest now, then Export CSV. Expect: The table shows keyword rows with dates as columns and positions, 101 shown as '100+'; a city filter lists the site's cities; Export CSV downloads a file whose first line is site,city,keyword,date,pc_position,mobile_position,found_url; in Russian BB the tab is «Отчёты».
